name: NexSyrus RED ALERT
operating_rule: Research is not browsing. Sales is not calling. Tech is not planning. Every task must end in an artifact, validated decision, logged activity, working build, or measurable result.

tasks.title: Audit current SchoolIMS architecture and produce a curriculum/sales technical dependency map.
Freeze the 10-day technical scope: what will be built, prototyped, mocked, or explicitly deferred.
Define the curriculum domain model: academic year, term, grade, subject, unit, chapter, lesson, objective, competency, activity, assessment, resource.
Design Supabase/Postgres schema extensions for curriculum with school_id isolation and migration safety.
Design curriculum versioning, draft-review-publish, rollback, and school-specific override model.
Define RBAC for management, staff, student, parent, curriculum reviewer, and future content-author roles.
Write API contracts for curriculum hierarchy, lesson plans, outcomes, assessments, resources, progress, and publishing.
Design offline-first read/cache/sync behavior for low-network schools, including conflict and stale-content rules.
Build a reusable curriculum seed/import pipeline so research outputs can become structured application data.
Prototype the staff Academic Plan + Curriculum workspace connected to real data contracts.
Prototype the student learning journey: today’s lesson, resources, practice, mastery, remediation, and progress.
Prototype the management curriculum dashboard: coverage, pacing, teacher completion, mastery gaps, and exceptions.
Implement/validate assessment data flow from question/assessment definition to student result and mastery evidence.
Implement the first deterministic remediation/recommendation rules using mastery thresholds and prerequisite gaps.
Design content asset storage, metadata, compression, caching, and access rules for PDFs, images, worksheets, and video.
Instrument curriculum analytics/events: lesson opened, resource used, assessment attempted, mastery changed, plan delayed.
Create a staging curriculum demo dataset for one school, two grades, two subjects, and one complete unit.
Build a principal-ready demo environment that cannot expose another school’s data or unstable internal screens.
Create the sales CRM technical foundation: lead stages, activities, next action, owner, territory, source, demo, proposal, outcome.
Build lead import, normalization, duplicate detection, and decision-maker/contact fields for bulk school prospecting.
Build Founder Sales Command dashboard: new leads, contacts, qualified, demos, proposals, pilots, wins/losses, aging, follow-up breaches.
Implement trackable brochure/demo QR links with source/campaign attribution and school/territory tagging.
Create structured field-feedback capture that routes feature requests, objections, and curriculum findings to the correct backlog.
Run security, tenant-isolation, permission, data-integrity, offline, and demo reliability tests; fix every P0/P1 defect.
Deploy the red-alert staging release, verify backups/monitoring/logging, and publish the technical handover + 30-day build backlog.
Write the one-page NexSyrus Curriculum doctrine: what learning problem we solve, for whom, and what we refuse to become.
Freeze the pilot: exact board/context, two grades, two subjects, one term, target school type, and non-goals.
Build a 50-question research instrument covering principal pain, teacher workload, classroom reality, assessment, parent pressure, and learning gaps.
Map official learning expectations for the pilot grades/subjects and create a standards evidence file with source references.
Teardown at least 10 curriculum/LMS/content competitors across philosophy, structure, teacher workflow, assessment, analytics, and implementation.
Conduct at least 8 structured interviews with principals/teachers and convert every interview into problem-frequency-severity evidence.
Design the NexSyrus academic hierarchy and terminology guide that every future product/content person must follow.
Define competency taxonomy and observable mastery evidence for the pilot subjects.
Create prerequisite/progression maps showing what learners must know before, during, and after each pilot unit.
Design the standard 40-minute classroom lesson model with minute-level teacher actions, student actions, resources, and checks.
Create the full assessment architecture: diagnostic, formative, practice, exit ticket, chapter/unit, term, rubric, and re-test.
Design the misconception library format: misconception, evidence signal, likely cause, teacher action, student activity, re-check.
Build one gold-standard complete unit: objectives, lessons, activities, worksheet, assessment, rubric, remediation, extension, teacher guide.
Test that unit with at least 5 teachers; measure prep time, confusion points, feasibility, and perceived workload reduction.
Produce a ranked list of the top 30 teacher-workload problems and exactly how curriculum + SchoolIMS should remove or reduce them.
Create Curriculum Authoring SOP: research → outline → write → academic review → classroom test → revision → publish → version.
Create a hard QA rubric for accuracy, age fit, cognitive load, clarity, classroom feasibility, inclusivity, assessment alignment, and evidence.
Define three learner pathways—support, core, advanced—with objective triggers and teacher interventions.
Create annual → term → month → week → lesson pacing architecture, including holidays, exams, revision, backlog, and recovery.
Design teacher planning workflow that can be completed in 15 minutes per week using the curriculum system.
Define parent academic visibility: what parents see weekly/monthly, what they should not see, and how to avoid data overload.
Create 12 defensible curriculum USPs with proof mechanism, school outcome, teacher outcome, and demo evidence for each.
Write Curriculum Framework v0.9: philosophy, hierarchy, outcomes, pedagogy, assessment, remediation, planning, QA, governance, feedback loop.
Run a hostile review: list 30 reasons a principal/teacher could reject NexSyrus Curriculum and redesign the framework against the strongest objections.
Freeze Curriculum Framework v1.0 + pilot research report + unresolved assumptions register + 30-day validation roadmap.
Define the exact ICP using school size, fee band, geography, decision structure, current ERP state, pain signals, and disqualifiers.
Rank first-wave Telangana territories using school density, accessibility, travel efficiency, network strength, and conversion practicality.
Build and clean a minimum 150-school prospect database with school, location, phone, decision-maker status, source, and priority.
Identify at least 60 principal/owner/management decision-makers and create contact paths for each.
Complete a commercial teardown of 12 ERP/curriculum competitors: positioning, pricing signals, packaging, proof, onboarding, and weaknesses.
Run 15 discovery calls/interviews and capture the exact words schools use for pain, objections, buying triggers, and current workarounds.
Build the 30-second, 2-minute, and 10-minute SchoolIMS + Curriculum pitch without feature dumping.
Create the principal discovery framework: 20 questions, qualification rules, urgency signals, authority, budget signal, and next-step criteria.
Create four commercial packages/hypotheses: SchoolIMS, Curriculum, Combined, and Pilot—with clear boundaries and upgrade logic.
Create a 30-objection battlebook covering price, existing ERP, teacher resistance, internet, parents, migration, support, security, and trust.
Write Telugu + English outreach scripts for cold call, WhatsApp, referral introduction, revisit, and post-demo follow-up.
Create the 20-minute live-demo narrative: problem → workflow → proof → curriculum → management visibility → commercial next step.
Contact at least 50 qualified schools and log every outcome; no untracked calls or WhatsApp activity.
Secure at least 8 decision-maker meetings/demos or produce a written root-cause analysis for the gap.
Complete 5 deep principal meetings and create structured meeting notes, objections, buying signal, and next-action date.
Create proposal v1 with problem statement, solution scope, rollout, training, responsibilities, commercials, timeline, and assumptions.
Create pilot offer/MOU structure with duration, school responsibilities, success metrics, review point, and conversion path.
Build five follow-up sequences: new lead, qualified-no-demo, demo-no-decision, proposal, dormant/revival.
Deliver at least 5 complete demos; record where attention drops, which modules trigger interest, and which objections repeat.
Create lost-deal/rejection taxonomy and classify every negative response instead of writing 'not interested'.
Expand pipeline to 200 qualified school records and at least 75 identified decision-makers.
Create 4-week district visit clusters so every field day targets multiple nearby schools instead of single-school travel.
Run 30 structured follow-ups on warm prospects and force one next action: meeting, demo, proposal, pilot, nurture date, or lost reason.
Produce factual pipeline forecast by stage and age—without optimistic counting—and identify the 10 deals requiring founder intervention.
Freeze Sales Playbook v1 + 30-day attack plan with territory, activity, meetings, demos, proposals, pilots, and conversion review cadence.
Write a field-sales role scorecard based on 30/60/90-day outcomes, not generic responsibilities.
Create the Indeed-ready JD plus alternate versions for LinkedIn, local job groups, referrals, and campus placement cells.
Design the complete hiring funnel: application → phone screen → aptitude → role-play → field scenario → founder → verification → offer.
Build a weighted interview scorecard for communication, persistence, travel readiness, learning speed, discipline, integrity, local network, and digital comfort.
Create a 50-question interview bank plus 15 red-flag probes and clear pass/fail evidence for each stage.
Build the candidate tracker with source, district, stage, score, salary, notice period, travel readiness, rejection reason, and owner.
Launch sourcing and generate at least 75 relevant candidate leads/applications across platforms, referrals, campuses, and local networks.
Complete at least 20 structured phone screens and reject weak candidates early instead of carrying them forward.
Run at least 8 principal-selling role plays with hard objections, local-language switching, and meeting-closing scenarios.
Design the 5-day Sales Bootcamp: company, school market, SchoolIMS, curriculum, discovery, demo, objection handling, CRM, field discipline.
Build the salesperson certification exam: product, pitch, objection, demo, CRM, field plan, ethics, and role-play minimum standards.
Create the 'DO NOT SAY / DO NOT DO' field guide covering fake promises, technical jargon, instant discounting, feature dumping, and unlogged follow-up.
Own the 2-page brochure production: hierarchy, copy placement, screenshots/visual proof, curriculum story, trust elements, CTA, and QR handoff.
Produce brochure v1 print proof and run a 5-person comprehension test: what they understand in 30 seconds and what confuses them.
Create salesperson training workbook with personas, discovery sheet, demo checklist, objection drills, field planner, and daily review sheet.
Design future 15-person Telangana territory model: district ownership, travel radius, school universe, backup coverage, and escalation path.
Create daily/weekly salesperson KPI system: attempts, conversations, decision-makers, meetings, demos, proposals, follow-ups, referrals, conversion.
Design incentive/recognition principles tied to quality outcomes and collections—not just raw lead counts.
Run two internal bootcamp simulations and score every participant using the same future-hire certification standard.
Create manager coaching system: call review, demo review, ride-along checklist, objection clinic, pipeline review, corrective action.
Produce a shortlist of hireable candidates with evidence, risks, compensation expectation, territory fit, and training gaps.
Create 30-day new-salesperson onboarding calendar from classroom training to shadowing to supervised field work to independent territory.
Build hiring funnel metrics and diagnose source quality, pass rates, rejection reasons, no-shows, and expected cost per hire.
Create Sales Operations Handbook: CRM discipline, lead ownership, follow-up SLA, visit planning, expenses, reporting, escalation, and handovers.
Deliver the complete Sales Scale Kit v1: JD, sourcing, scorecards, interviews, bootcamp, certification, brochure, territories, KPIs, onboarding, coaching.
